explanation: A Fund programme is a political act before it is a technical one. It needs a government able to survive the devaluation and the cuts it commits to. The two years before this election had produced no such government. The alliance was breaking up and the balance of payments got worse through it. The Bloco Central took office in June 1983 with the two largest parties inside it and went to the Fund in the autumn. That government is what made the programme possible and what let it be carried out. Whether the recession that followed was worth it is argued about. That this government allowed the agreement to be signed is not.
